[Story]
In a coffee shop, the waitress Xiao Li is serving drinks to customers. She tells the customer Xiao Zhang, "We offer 30 different types of coffee, most are lattes, some are cappuccinos, but there are almost no American coffees." Xiao Zhang checks the menu and finds only 4 types of cappuccinos.

[Question]
Before Xiao Zhang checks the menu, how many types of lattes does he guess?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Before Xiao Zhang checks the menu, he guesses there are 26 types of lattes.
B. Before Xiao Zhang checks the menu, he guesses there are 29 types of lattes.
C. Before Xiao Zhang checks the menu, he guesses there are 30 types of lattes.
D. Before Xiao Zhang checks the menu, he guesses there are 10 types of lattes.
